test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He told me that I could eat from his plate.

options.text: He said, “ You can eat from my plate.”
He said to me, “Can you eat from my plate?”
He said, “I can eat from my plate.”
He said to me, “You can eat from my plate.”

solution:
The correct answer is **'He said to me, “You can eat from my plate.” **'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence in the indirect speech is in the **Past Tense.** Therefore, the sentence in the direct speech will be in **Present Tense.**
